visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, straight dark hair and fair skin sits indoors on a dark green leather sofa. She is wearing a black long-sleeved mock-neck top, gray trousers, a silver necklace with a circular pendant, and several silver rings. Behind her is a warm-toned orange wood-paneled wall. She holds a black padded makeup pouch with a white label that reads 'MAISON HUIUKI' (mirrored). (2) She opens the pouch to show it is densely packed with various cosmetics. She pulls out a silver spray bottle of Fancl mist and a white tube of Bobbi Brown Vitamin Enriched Face Base. She holds them up for the camera while gesturing with her free hand. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features. (3) She presents a pink-labeled bottle of M.A.C. Strobe Cream, waving her hand as she describes it. Next, she shows a white NARS cushion foundation case. A close-up shot focuses on her face, showcasing her smooth makeup and subtle eye shadow. She continues to cycle through items, showing a tfit concealer palette and an I'M MEME concealer tube, pointing to the areas of her face where she applies them. (4) She holds up a black Solone setting spray and a black SUQQU powder compact. She taps her nose and cheeks to indicate application. Then, she reveals a Kai Beauty eyeshadow palette with nine neutral shades and a Makeup Forever double-ended brush. (5) She displays a collection of eye products including Peripera eyebrow pencils, Ettusais eyeliner, and a Misel Ady liquid liner. She demonstrates the eyeliner on the side of her eye. She follows with a Shu Uemura brow fixing liquid and a Hince dual-ended eye pen. (6) She holds three mascara tubes simultaneously: 1028, Face Factory, and Wonjungyo. A macro close-up shows her long, separated eyelashes. She then shows a LashGuardian mascara and a Canmake mascara. (7) She presents a SUQQU blush palette and Canmake contour/highlight compacts. She applies the contour to her jawline and highlight to her cheekbone. (8) Finally, she shows lip care items: a Canmake scrub, VT Cosmetics lip plumper, and a Chanel dual-ended liquid lipstick. She holds her finger to her lips, showing a close-up of the glossy finish. She ends by holding the full makeup bag again and smiling.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short, dark bob-style hair, wearing a black mock-neck long-sleeve top and gray pants. She has multiple silver rings and a necklace.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic indoor setting featuring a dark green leather sofa or banquette with a blue and white patterned throw pillow. The wall behind is composed of orange-brown vertical wood panels.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy female voice speaks in Mandarin, introducing her travel makeup contents. An upbeat, acoustic-style background track with bright guitar strumming and a light drum beat plays continuously. The voice has a high arousal level and friendly tone. (2) As she discusses specific products, subtle percussive thuds and the light rustle of plastic are heard as she handles various makeup items. The vocal delivery is fast-paced with clear articulation. The music remains steady in volume and tempo. (3) A distinct mechanical click is heard as a compact lid is closed. The narrator's pitch rises slightly when expressing excitement about a particular brand. The background music maintains a cheerful, major-mode atmosphere without interruption. (4) The audio continues with high information density. Small clinks of glass or hard plastic containers touching each other occur throughout the speech. The voice maintains a professional narrative quality, with rising intonations used to highlight list items. (5) Toward the conclusion, the vocal energy remains high. The music concludes abruptly with a hard cut at the end of the final sentence, leaving a clean finish to the studio-quality recording.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Intro -> Systematic Item Demonstration -> Summary/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comprehensive 'What's in my bag' travel edition, where the creator shares her curated selection of makeup products used during a trip to Seoul. She aims to provide recommendations for high-performing, travel-friendly cosmetics by demonstrating their textures and application methods, appealing to beauty enthusiasts looking for product inspiration.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of multiple brand-name products with positive commentary and specific mentions of their benefits (e.g., NARS, SUQQU, Chanel).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density editing and a multi-product showcase format typical of social media beauty influencers to maintain high viewer engagement.
